profile.name: Dilip Kumar S
profile.summary: AI & Data Science Engineer helping businesses turn ideas into practical AI solutions and full-stack applications, with hands-on experience in machine learning, computer vision, generative AI, Java, Spring Boot, and Angular. Currently working as a Programmer Analyst at Cognizant.

education.institution: GK Shetty Vivekananda Vidyalaya Junior College

highlights: Contributed to the development of a complex financial regulatory reporting system (RegReportX).
Engaged in full-stack development using Angular for the front end and Java/Spring Boot for backend API integration.
Collaborated with the team to build scalable enterprise banking modules and improve reporting workflows.
Completed technical training and foundation development in Angular and Spring Boot full-stack engineering.
Assisted in initial module setups and API integrations for regulatory reporting applications.
Implemented a live meeting video summarizer that increases efficiency by 80%.
Developed a gesture-based meeting summarizer to assist in presentations during meetings.
Implemented the Insightify web system to offer personalized learning for students and freshers.

experience.organization: Brainovision Solutions India Pvt. Ltd. / FutureSkills Prime

projects.title: Regulatory Reporting System – RegReportX
projects.description: Developed a regulatory reporting platform to streamline data validation, exception handling, and report generation workflows.
highlights: Implemented role-based modules for Operation Officers, Compliance Analysts, Risk Analysts, and Reporting Officers to ensure controlled data processing and governance.
Designed and integrated RESTful APIs for data ingestion, correction logs, and report lifecycle management.
Built responsive user interfaces using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS to enable efficient user interaction and workflow tracking.
Implemented automated notification workflows to improve coordination between different user roles and enhance reporting efficiency.

projects.title: Insightfy – AI-Based Course Recommendation System
projects.description: Built a course recommendation system integrating Udemy, Coursera, and edX data, filtered by title, rating, and difficulty.
highlights: Integrated course data from multiple platforms.
Performed ETL processes on course data from multiple APIs.
Standardized and cleaned data for model training and deployment.
Applied collaborative and content-based filtering algorithms to analyze user history and course features.
Built a user-friendly interface to improve course discovery and user experience.

projects.title: AI-Based Healthcare Assistant – Lumina
projects.description: Developed a multi-functional AI healthcare assistant integrating prescription analysis, wound detection using a custom YOLO model, and psychometric testing for mental health monitoring.
highlights: Integrated Gemini Flash 1.5 for real-time prescription interpretation and health-related queries.
Implemented wound detection using a custom YOLO model.
Implemented a psychometric testing module with sentiment analysis.
Designed the system to identify early signs of mental health distress and provide triage recommendations.
Utilized LangChain to create an interactive conversational agent for health inquiries.
Provided personalized and context-aware responses.

projects.title: AGV Path Tracking and Navigation System
projects.description: Developing an industrial AGV prototype with autonomous navigation, featuring lane detection and CNN-based steering prediction, with plans to add object detection for improved navigation and safety.
highlights: Implemented lane detection and CNN-based steering prediction.
Implemented A* algorithm for shortest-path optimization with turn control.
Integrated turn decisions into navigation.
Employed a real-time localization system combining ultrasonic sensor data and camera input.
Designed the system to support switching between autonomous lane-following and manual override modes for operational safety.

projects.title: AI-Powered Newspaper OCR & Summarization
projects.description: This project automates news extraction and summarization from newspaper articles using AI techniques. The system extracts images and text, generates a structured summary, and provides AI-generated voice narration for the news.
highlights: Users upload a newspaper image, and a custom YOLOv8 model trained using Roboflow detects and extracts images and text from the article.
Gemini Vision enhances OCR text extraction accuracy.
Generates a structured AI summary of the article.
Uses an OpenAI model for AI-generated voice narration of the summary.
Final output includes a play button for narration, a news summary with key points, and a description of extracted images.
